'''Clan Lok''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan in existence prior to the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|When we leave, Vizla will say we are not Mando'ade, and those sheb'urcyin who have forgotten what that word means will agree with her. But if what she has made us is "Mando'ade," then I want no part of it. I will be ash'ad. I will be someone else.|[[Mirli Lok]]|<ref name="TOR:TA" />}}
During the Great Galactic War, [[Mandalore the Vindicated|Artus Lok]] was a member of the clan,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who won the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], a Mandalorian galaxy-wide competition for glory. Artus went on to claim the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], the traditional leader of the Mandalorian clans, after challenging and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[Mandalore the Lesser|previous ''Mand'alor'']].<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|mandalore|Mandalore}}</ref>

During the Cold War, Artus, now called Mandalore the Vindicated, offered the [[Hunter (individual)|latest Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] to join Clan Lok and the Champion gladly accepted.<ref name="TOR:THoD" />

[[File:Ashad.png|thumb|left|250px|The Ash'ad on Onderon]]
During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] on the galaxy, Clan Lok met them head on and fought against the invaders. However, they were hit hard by the [[Eternal Empire]] and Mandalore the Vindicated fell in battle, killed by swarms of [[skytrooper]]s.<ref name="TOR:TFoMtV">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Fall of Mandalore the Vindicated}}</ref> The Clan scattered soon after,<ref name="TOR:TA" /> and a stigma against [[Droid/Legends|droids]] formed due to Mandalore's death.<ref name="TOR:TFoMtV" /> Eventually, the new Mandalore, [[Mandalore the Avenger]], planned to [[Raid on Darvannis|assault]] the Eternal Empire's [[Darvannis factory|factory]] on [[Darvannis]] to help rearm themselves, but [[Mirli Lok]] disagreed with her plan, viewing it as dishonorable to wage war against mere droids and preferring to fight [[Zakuul]] directly. Mirli convinced others to break off from Vizla's leadership, forming the [[Ash'ad]]. They would then go to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] in order to hunt the dangerous beasts of the world in pursuit of honor and glory,<ref name="TOR:TA" /> but many were slain by the [[Alliance Commander]] on Mandalore's orders.<ref name="TOR:SftD">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Scorn for the Dishonored|Onderon}}</ref> The remnants of the Ash'ad, under the leadership of [[Durn Wynnward]], integrated into the splinter faction known as the [[Hidden Chain]].<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=flashpoint|Spirit of Vengeance}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Clan Lok first appeared in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], albeit unnamed, in the [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', created by [[BioWare]] and released [[December 20]], [[2011]]. The tie-in reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', identified the Mandalorian clan as "Lok."<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Clan Lok was later mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''.<ref name="TOR:TFoMtV" />
